text: Good evening. I have my grandson tonight, he is 20 months. He has the chickenpox, itchy blisters all over, but otherwise he has been himself. I noticed some different marks tonight, not like the pox at all. Little dark dots, flat, like someone has dotted him with the tip of a pen. It is hard to see on his skin, he is very dark, so I looked on the palms of his hands and the bottoms of his feet and they show up there, and a couple inside his lip I think. I pressed a glass on his foot and they did not go away, they stayed just the same. He has not had any fits or shaking or anything like that. I may be fussing but I thought it best to let you know.
